basic_profile.bio: I'm a 26-year-old software engineer living in Austin, Texas. I recently got into Reddit during a tough time in my life, and I've found it to be a supportive community. I love dogs, comedy podcasts, and exploring online communities. I'm not a fan of negativity or toxic environments. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work, around 7-10 PM. I'm currently single and trying to navigate the complexities of post-breakup life.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science from the University of Texas. I've been working in the tech industry for about 4 years, mainly focusing on backend development. I've always been a curious person, learning new technologies through online courses and community forums.
